note: docs/ top-level whitelist + second-level whitelist + orphan-scan policy (single source of truth for tools/audit_docs.ps1). New top-level docs/ entries must be registered here. B3 (2026-10-24) collapsed rootFiles from 24 to 1: every reference doc moved into a topic directory, only 项目全景说明.md stays at the root as the entry point. Phase B2 = report only; phase B6 wires the audit into tools/run_gates.ps1 as fail-closed. B4 (2026-10-24) added docs/README.md as the docs hub (registered in rootFiles) and tools/gen_docs_index.ps1 which generates INDEX.md for every journal dir. B7 (2026-10-24) moved the 23 plugin doc directories under docs/代码/<domain>/ : top-level dirs 42 -> 19, and the second level of docs/代码/ is now pinned by codeDirs so a new plugin doc directory cannot appear unnoticed.

codeDirs.note: Second-level whitelist for docs/代码/. Domain -> allowed plugin doc directories. Any directory under docs/代码/<domain>/ not listed here is a TOP violation. A file directly under docs/代码/ or under a domain directory with no plugin subdir is also a violation.

orphanPolicy.note: Two class of .md live under docs/: REFERENCE docs (design/architecture/guide - must be reachable from some README) and JOURNAL docs (dated change records, meeting minutes, perf runs - indexed by date, not by README link). ORPHAN is only meaningful for REFERENCE docs. Journal directories are exempt; reference directories are NOT.
orphanPolicy.why: 2026-10-24 first run reported ORPHAN=386 of which 392 files were code-changes entries alone. Counting journal entries as orphans makes the metric useless (never actionable) and hides the real signal: reference docs nobody can find.

readmePolicy.note: NOREADME applies to directories that are meant to be navigated. Journal dirs get a generated INDEX file instead of a hand-written README - tracked as a separate phase (B4).
readmePolicy.why: A README is a human-written map. For 392 dated entries the correct artifact is a generated index (B4), not a README that will rot on the next commit.

_phaseNotes.B2: Whitelist reflects the CURRENT state so the audit reports only genuine drift.
_phaseNotes.B3: DONE 2026-10-24. Root files 24 -> 1 (only 项目全景说明.md). Moved: handoffs -> 架构文档/交接报告/, baselines -> 架构文档/基线/, design docs -> 工程纪律 + 基础设施, protocol matrix -> 通信协议矩阵/, variable mgmt -> 数据记录/. Retired docs/ProjectOverview.md (tombstone at 架构文档/ProjectOverview-退役说明.md).
_phaseNotes.B4: DONE 2026-10-24. tools/gen_docs_index.ps1 generates an INDEX.md per journal dir (code-changes/meetings/performance). Re-run after adding entries; the generator is idempotent and date-descending. INDEX.md is NOT a README: the orphan scan still requires a journal ENTRY to be reachable, so a journal entry that nobody links is still reported.
_phaseNotes.B6: Flip audit_docs.ps1 from report-only to fail-closed by calling it from tools/run_gates.ps1.
_phaseNotes.B7: DONE 2026-10-24. 23 plugin doc directories moved under docs/代码/<domain>/ (6 domains covering all 39 plugin projects); 38 dated change records moved from those directories into code-changes/YYYY-MM/ (journal dirs are orphan-exempt, so bundling them there is the intended home). schemaVersion 2 -> 3 adds codeDirs. Set FORCE_TOP=1 style drift is not wanted: to add a plugin doc directory, register it under the matching domain first.
